records.title: Less is KEN: a Universal and Simple Non-Parametric Pruning Algorithm for Large Language Models
records.reason: KEN is a non-parametric unstructured pruning algorithm for LLMs based on kernel density estimation that preserves significant parameters and stores only the optimized subnetwork; direct LLM pruning for deployment.

records.title: UltraViT: Latency-Optimized On-device Vision Encoder for Large Vision-Language Models
records.reason: UltraViT designs a pyramidal vision encoder explicitly optimized against measured on-device latencies for large vision-language models; direct inference-latency optimization of an LVLM component.

records.title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
records.reason: Second Thought forks auxiliary reasoning branches that decode concurrently during ReAct action/observation idle windows and merges them back, relocating reasoning into otherwise wasted inference time; a direct inference-time execution framework.

records.title: Video Codec-Guided Training-Free Token Compression for Video Large Language Models
records.reason: Uses video codec motion vectors, residuals and reference dependencies as a cheap prior for training-free visual token compression in video LLMs; direct inference token compression for VLLMs.
